channel.title: Stephen Mante Anti: Blog
channel.description: Essays and notes by Stephen Mante Anti.

item.title: The Nima boy who came home in a Rolls-Royce
item.description: The obituaries remembered Kofi Wayo as a politician. His real story is Ghanaian migration in one life: Nima, Albany, Detroit, and a flashy homecoming.

item.title: Once again, like the ostrich, we put our head in the sand
item.description: A Ghanaian father brought his son to the Bronx for a better life, and the boy was shot on his way to school. Mocking the father is easier than asking why so many families leave.

item.title: Who walks the girl out at night?
item.description: The Obuasi SHTS case is about one headmaster. The silence around it belongs to all of us: schools, churches, mosques and offices.
